market_summary: Global equity markets faced mixed sentiment at end-October 2026. Singapore's banking sector remained in focus with DBS and OCBC reporting strong results and recognition, while UOB awaits Q3 earnings on November 4. Singapore Airlines extended Middle East flight cancellations to February 2027 due to geopolitical tensions, offsetting positive sustainable aviation fuel commitments. US tech earnings season is ramping up with Apple set to report November 2; analysts expect $1.99 EPS on $113.31 billion revenue amid iPhone Duo launch and holiday quarter guidance scrutiny.

items.headline: CGS International upgrades DBS to Add, raises target to SGD 79.50
items.summary: CGS International upgraded DBS Group to Add from Hold and raised its price target from SGD 77.10 to SGD 79.50, citing 20% return on equity and strong earnings base.

items.headline: DBS Q2 2026 net profit rises 9% year-over-year to SGD 3.1 billion
items.summary: DBS Group reported second-quarter 2026 net profit of SGD 3.1 billion, up 9% from the year-earlier quarter, with wealth management fees rising 42% to SGD 919 million.

items.headline: DBS Group lists USD 1.5 billion of bonds in Singapore
items.summary: DBS Group arranged USD 1.5 billion of bonds, a financing milestone reflecting strong market access as the bank manages capital ahead of third-quarter results.

items.headline: OCBC recognized as strongest bank in Singapore and Asia Pacific by The Asian Banker
items.summary: OCBC was named the strongest bank in Singapore and Asia Pacific and third globally in The Asian Banker's World's 1,000 Strongest Banks ranking, cementing its position after topping Forbes and Statista rankings.

items.headline: OCBC launches Alipay+ Travel Treat for overseas digital payments rewards
items.summary: OCBC launched an in-app travel rewards service for overseas Alipay+ QR payments, broadening its digital banking offer and customer engagement.

items.headline: UOB Q3 earnings scheduled for November 4; analyst consensus targets SGD 43.36
items.summary: United Overseas Bank scheduled to publish third-quarter 2026 results on November 4, with analyst consensus target of SGD 43.36 against current share price near SGD 41.50.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines to purchase up to 4,800 tonnes of sustainable aviation fuel from Aether over three years
items.summary: Singapore Airlines signed agreement with Aether Fuels to purchase SAF from Singapore-based plant over three years starting 2028, supporting net-zero emissions by 2050.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines extends Dubai flight cancellations to February 28, 2027 due to Middle East geopolitical situation
items.summary: Singapore Airlines extended cancellation of Singapore-Dubai flights (SQ494/SQ495) to February 28, 2027, citing ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

items.headline: Apple to report Q4 2026 earnings on November 2; holiday guidance in focus
items.summary: Apple will release Q4 2026 earnings after market close November 2, with analysts forecasting EPS of $1.99 on revenue of $113.31 billion amid iPhone Duo launch.
